test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, “My mother will be here tomorrow.”

options.text: He said that his mother would be there the next day.
He said that his mother would be here tomorrow.
He said that my mother will be here tomorrow.
He said that my mother will be here the next day.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that his mother would be there the next day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"My mother will be here tomorrow" becomes "his mother would be there the next day"**
 
 
• Pronou
